newsitem.title: USA: TRW says helicopter deal boosted by $20 mln.
newsitem.headline: TRW says helicopter deal boosted by $20 mln.

text.p: TRW Inc on Thursday said it has signed an agreement with Boeing Co's helicopters division adding to a current avionics program for the U.S. Army and boosting the total contract value by $20 million.

In a statement, TRW said the deal extends an existing contract for the Comanche helicopters' communications, navigations and identifications systems. It increases the contract value to $113 million from $93 million.
The original agreement's scope was broadened in January from prototype development to an operational program, which at the time boosted the value to $93 million from $37 million.
